name: Rushabh Dabare
resumeText:
## Summary
Software Developer with 2+ years of professional experience building web applications using React.js, JavaScript, ASP.NET Core Web API, and SQL Server. Experienced in developing reusable React components, integrating REST APIs, and working with Dapper for database-driven backend applications. Possesses hands-on experience with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker, and full-stack application development. Strong foundation in object-oriented programming, databases, REST APIs, and software development practices.

## Professional Experience

### Software Developer, Seaker Systems Private Limited (April 2024 - Present)
*   Developed and maintained scalable web applications with React.js, focusing on REST API integration, component-driven UI architecture, and efficient client-side state management using Zustand.
*   Collaborated on backend API development using ASP.NET Core Web API, following Onion Architecture and Dapper ORM, delivering performance-optimized, maintainable server-side logic with MSSQL.
*   Contributed to migrating legacy UI screens to a modern React architecture using React Hook Form and React Query, reducing repetitive code and improving client-side API data handling through caching and server-state management.
*   Developed reusable MUI input components and configurable Kendo UI Grid components to promote consistency and reduce repetitive UI implementation.
*   Refactored a large, tightly coupled React codebase into modular and reusable components, significantly reducing application build time and improving maintainability.
*   Implemented Docker-based build pipelines for frontend deployment and managed IIS server configurations on remote environments, supporting smooth CI/CD workflows.
*   Practiced Agile development methodologies, actively participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and cross-functional team collaboration.
*   **Tech Stack**: React.js, JavaScript, MUI, React Query, React Hook Form, Zustand, Kendo UI, C#, ASP.NET Core (Web API / Dapper), MSSQL, REST APIs, Docker, IIS, Git.

## Projects

### Nutrition with Ruchika – Full-Stack Booking & CMS Platform (Website | GitHub)
*   Developed a full-stack nutrition consultancy platform with an online appointment booking system and role-protected admin CMS.
*   Developed Spring Boot REST APIs and PostgreSQL-backed data models for appointments, payments, users, and dynamic website content.
*   Implemented server-side appointment slot validation before Razorpay order creation to prevent conflicting bookings and handled concurrent booking attempts.
*   Integrated Razorpay with server-side order creation and HMAC-SHA256 payment signature verification.
*   Built reusable admin CRUD components for managing dynamic website sections.
*   Configured Spring Security for admin authentication, endpoint authorization, CORS, and CSRF handling.
*   Used Supabase PostgreSQL with database-level Row-Level Security policies and configured SMTP/Brevo email notifications.
*   Dockerized and deployed the Spring Boot backend on Render, and deployed the React frontend on Vercel.
*   **Tech Stack**: React.js, Spring Boot, Java, PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Razorpay, Docker.

### TrackFlow – Project & Task Management Platform (GitHub) (January 2024 – March 2024)
*   Developed a project and task management platform with a React-based frontend and backend services using ASP.NET Web API, Spring Boot, and Express.js.
*   Built React forms and reusable UI components using React Hook Form and integrated backend functionality through REST APIs.
*   Designed relational MySQL tables for organizational hierarchies, project assignments, and task management.
*   Tested and validated REST APIs using Postman and handled frontend-backend integration across the application.
*   **Tech Stack**: React.js, React Hook Form, Express.js, Spring Boot, ASP.NET WebAPI, MySQL, Bootstrap, REST APIs, Postman, Git.
bioNotes: Looking for active vacancies in Pune, Mumbai, or Hyderabad.
